products.title: Money Plant (Devil's Ivy)
products.description: Popular indoor money plant (Epipremnum aureum) known for its air-purifying qualities. Easy to grow in pots or hanging baskets.

symbolism.origin: In Vastu Shastra and Feng Shui traditions, Epipremnum aureum is renowned as the primary living magnet for wealth, prosperity, and positive domestic chi.

growing_instructions: Plant or repot in well-drained loamy compost during mild spring weather from April to June.
Active vine expansion occurs from May through September in bright, indirect indoor sunlight.
Tender to Kashmir's freezing winters; keep strictly indoors in heated rooms away from frost and cold window drafts from November through March.
Dormant during winter; reduce watering to once every 10-14 days from December through February.
care_instructions: Water according to species and season: more in summer, reduced in winter and cloudy spells.
Top-dress with compost every 6-8 weeks and remove spent or yellowing foliage.
Prune shape-forming shrubs in late winter before active spring flush.
Monitor for mealybugs, scale, and fungal leaf spots; isolate and treat early.

products.title: Rubber Plant (Large)
products.description: Popular indoor plant with large, glossy, deep green leaves. Excellent air purifier. Grows into a statement piece with minimal care.

symbolism.origin: In botanical lore and Feng Shui, Ficus elastica represents abundance, resilience, grounding strength, and financial stability due to its thick, sturdy, oval leaves.

growing_instructions: Repot into rich, aerated potting soil between April and June as indoor spring temperatures rise.
Foliage expands steadily from May to September in bright, filtered sunlight.
Not frost hardy in Kashmir; maintain indoors at 15°C+ with protection from sub-zero drafts and heater vents from November through March.
Growth slows from December to February; water sparingly only when the top 3 inches of potting mix feel dry.

products.title: Snake Plant
products.description: Striking upright succulent with variegated leaves. Extremely tough and low-maintenance. Excellent air purifier for any space.

symbolism.origin: In Asian and African folk traditions, the upright sword leaves of Sansevieria symbolize a protective shield against negative energy, embodying clean energy and resolute endurance.

growing_instructions: Repot or divide rhizomes in spring between April and June in gritty potting compost.
Steady vegetative growth occurs across warm summer months from June through August.
Vulnerable to freezing winter damage in Srinagar; house indoors year-round, especially November through March.
Near-dormant from December to February; water only once a month or less to prevent cold wet root rot.
care_instructions: Water according to species and season: more in summer, reduced in winter and cloudy spells.
Top-dress with compost every 6-8 weeks and remove spent or yellowing foliage.
Prune shape-forming shrubs in late winter before active spring flush.
Monitor for mealybugs, scale, and fungal leaf spots; isolate and treat early.

products.title: Spider Plant
products.description: Classic indoor plant with arching, striped leaves. Produces baby plantlets (spiderettes) on runners. Easy care and excellent air purifier.

symbolism.origin: As a prolific producer of baby plantlets ('spiderettes'), Chlorophytum comosum has long symbolized domestic fertility, renewal, abundance, and effortless cleansing.

growing_instructions: Repot parent plants or root plantlet runners in fresh compost during mid-spring from April to May.
Produces rapid runner offsets and lush foliage throughout summer from May to August.
Sensitive to winter frost damage in Kashmir; requires indoor room temperatures from November through March.
Growth slows during cold months from December to February; allow topsoil to dry before watering.
